notes.title: DevLog #3 - Ready for Demo
notes.content:
Hello there again,

I'm Murat, creator and developer of the game.
Last month was tough. But we are hanging there. 
There was a lot of problems that we need to solve. But finally we did.

Latest Updates;
- All foot gear abilities are implemented. Dash, Stomp, Levitate, Range Attacks.
- 3 types of enemies and their AI are added
- I composed some basic Menu and Background music for game. (They are not bad but ok I guess)
- Sounds effects are added (This part is really hard, there was a second I almost decided that I will do them with my mouth)
- Main Menu and In-game Menu is working well.
- Save system is added. There are some imperfections but nothing big.
- Started to build a mini map system. A metroidvanian without a map cannot exist.
- Many many minor bugs are fixed.

Thanks for your support. I will post news more frequently. Stay in touch and don't forget:
Add the game to your wishlists :D

-Murat Karakaş
